result.summary: The page renders mostly correctly, but there is a clear data-formatting bug in the 'Fastest near you' carousel where a delivery fee shows as '€NaN'. A minor styling inconsistency also exists between the favorite (heart) buttons on the 'Popular right now' cards.

issues.description: The 'Smash Bros Burgers' card in the 'Fastest near you' row displays '€NaN delivery' instead of a valid price, indicating an undefined/non-numeric delivery fee value leaking into the UI.
issues.suggestion: Validate and coerce the delivery fee before formatting; fall back to a sensible label (e.g. 'Free delivery', '—' or hide the line) when the value is missing or not a number.

issues.description: The favorite heart button on the pizza card in 'Popular right now' uses a dark/semi-opaque circular background while the equivalent button on the ramen card above uses a white circle, creating inconsistent control styling between identical card types.
issues.suggestion: Standardize the favorite button style (same background colour, opacity and icon colour) across all restaurant cards, or apply a consistent scrim behind it regardless of image brightness.
